For batch 95, the exponential model  
\(t_{\text{to }45^\circ\text{C}} = 32.7764 - (-10410.9)\bigl(e^{8.17026\times10^{-6}\cdot k} - 1\bigr)\)  
yields  

\[
t_{\text{to }45^\circ\text{C}}(95) \approx 32.7764 + 10410.9\bigl(e^{0.000776175} - 1\bigr) \approx 40.86\ \text{min}.
\]

The held‑out validation mean absolute error for this model is **0.29 min** (0.293973 min from the table), which serves as the noise floor for the estimate.
